title: Congenital hearing loss (GJB2)
summary: Changes in the GJB2 gene are a common genetic cause of hearing loss that is present from birth. Hearing loss can range from mild to profound.
inheritance_plain: GJB2 hearing loss is usually inherited in an autosomal recessive way: a child is affected only if they get a changed copy from both parents.
carrier_meaning: A carrier has one changed copy and usually has typical hearing.
disease_meaning: A child with two changed copies has hearing loss. Early support, such as hearing aids, cochlear implants and sign language, helps children develop and communicate.
screening: Newborn hearing screening finds hearing loss early, whatever the cause.
